name: pybind11-navigate
description: Go from Python symbols to pybind11 registrations in the workspace.

pybind11Navigation.include.description: Glob for C++ binding sources, relative to each workspace folder.

pybind11Navigation.exclude.description: Glob for paths to skip while indexing.

pybind11Navigation.moduleMap.description: Map full Python import paths to names used in PYBIND11_MODULE.

pybind11Navigation.useClangd.description: Use the installed clangd extension's AST when available and fall back to source indexing otherwise.

pybind11Navigation.pythonPath.description: Python 3 executable for parsing source. Leave empty to use python3 (python on Windows).
